name: Convergent Giant Eagle AP OLD
languages: can't speak any language, convergent link

generalAbilities.name: Convergent Link
generalAbilities.description:
Creatures with this ability can communicate with each other by manifesting an aura of wispy Utopian runes.

This has the effects of Telepathy with a range of 300 feet, but requires line of sight.

defensiveAbilities.name: Disrupted Link
defensiveAbilities.description: While a convergent giant eagle is Confused, Fascinated, or Frightened, it loses its convergent link and convergent tactics abilities.

defensiveAbilities.name: Evasion
defensiveAbilities.description: When a giant eagle succeeds at a Reflex save, it critically succeeds instead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Convergent Tactics
offensiveAbilities.description: The convergent eagle's attacks deal an extra 4d8 damage to creatures within reach of one of its allies with convergent tactics.

offensiveAbilities.name: Eagle Dive
offensiveAbilities.description: The giant eagle Flies up to double its fly Speed in a straight line, descending at least 10 feet, and then makes a talons Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Snatch
offensiveAbilities.description: A convergent eagle can Fly at half speed while it has a creature Grabbed or Restrained in its talons, carrying that creature along with it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
